blurb:
This private Victoria tour offers a refreshing change of pace, perfect for couples, seniors, and families. Designed around your interests, the tour combines local insight with comfort and flexibility.

Begin with a scenic drive through the countryside as you make your way to the world-renowned Butchart Gardens. Enjoy a self-guided stroll through vibrant floral displays, tranquil nature trails, and artistic garden spaces.

After the gardens, your private guide will lead you on a curated drive through Victoria’s highlights. Depending on your preferences, this may include historic Craigdarroch Castle, coastal neighborhoods, Canada’s oldest Chinatown, and the charming Inner Harbour.

This tour is designed to be enriching, and entirely private. Your guide will meet you at your hotel, cruise terminal, or if you're visiting on a day trip from Vancouver, at the BC Ferry Terminal, Harbour Air, or Helijet.

Our local guide understands how to make the most of your time, without rushing.
